answer: A ivory of per-task receipts records who did what, and the delta of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The cipher of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
